english.title: Fail to notify the official veterinary surgeon at the border control post of required information

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the case of transhipment of products, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCTS..), from one border control post to another, being the person responsible for a consignment failed to notify **(..SPECIFY NAME OF VETERINARY SURGEON..), the official veterinary surgeon at the border control post of destination, namely **(..SPECIFY BORDER CONTROL POST..), the information required under regulation 14(4) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION THAT WAS NOT DISCLOSED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(4), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
